scope: AArch64 single-core full-system QEMU boot bench

reproduction.source: git archive the candidate into two empty directories. From each kernel directory run cargo build --release --locked. Use the matching target ELF for each launch.
reproduction.normalization: $WORK replaces the temporary directory path. Process IDs, timestamps, UART bytes and process return codes are preserved.
reproduction.independent_observer: Launch QEMU from the recorded argv with separate UART/stdout and stderr pipes. Require the two full marker lines within 5 seconds, check that the process stays alive and UART stays quiet for a further second, then stop QEMU from the host. Timing fields measure the host observation only.
reproduction.negative_mutation: In a separate copy of kernel/src/start.S replace exactly str xzr, [x0], #8 with add x0, x0, #8. Build with the same locked command. Check for an empty UART during the specified negative deadline.
reproduction.public_runner: From the checkout root run python3 tools/qemu_boot.py --kernel kernel/target/aarch64-unknown-none/release/jnox-kernel in the emulator environment.

implementation_review: The ELF has two PT_LOAD headers (RX and RW), no dynamic interpreter. _start @ 0x40200000 masks interrupts and checks EL1, selects the 16-byte-aligned stack top 0x40204120 and enables EL1 FP/SIMD. The BSS probe spans the entire present 8-byte BSS, from 0x40200118 to 0x40200120 exclusive. After seeding all ones and clearing it, compiled Rust reloads the probe; a nonzero word parks in a WFE loop. A zero word leads to aligned 32-bit PL011 configuration and polling on the single-core MMU-off fixed emulated board, then WFE and branch back at 0x402000f0. Acceptance requires the specific emulator and starting state.
observer_scope: Two independent QEMU processes started with fresh memory. The independent observer used the default system emulator accelerator; x86_64 host cannot use hardware virtualization to execute this Arm guest. The public runner also explicitly supplied -accel tcg. The independent observer used SIGKILL only at end of observation (return code -9). Public runner used SIGTERM; QEMU diagnostics are separate.
